summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Sales Experience Platform - all core features functional. Landing page renders 10 industry cards, prospect name input works, industry navigation functions properly, all 6 tabs (Discovery, Command Center, Workflow, ROI, Case Studies, Trial CTA) render with correct content, Discovery Panel sliders update ROI calculations live, industry switching between Roofing and MedSpa shows different agents and color themes, back button navigation works correctly.
passed_tests: Landing page renders with 10 industry cards (roofing, medspa, hvac, dental, auto_dealership, construction, law_firm, real_estate, landscaping, pools)
Prospect name input field works and carries company name through all screens
Industry card selection transitions properly to demo layout
Discovery Panel loads with sliders and live ROI calculations
Current Reality vs With AI sections display correctly with company name
Command Center shows 6 industry-specific agent cards with metrics
Command Center pipeline funnel and live feed render correctly
Command Center stat cards display calculated values
Workflow tab loads with 6 workflow steps and before/after toggle
ROI tab displays 5 loss cards, 4 gain cards, charts, and payback period
Case Studies tab shows 4 pain point cards and 3 case study cards
Trial CTA tab renders benefits, value summary, CTA buttons, and 4 FAQ items
Tab navigation works for all 6 tabs via clicking
Back button successfully returns to industry selector
Industry switching: MedSpa shows different agents (Patient Inquiry, Appointment Booking, Treatment Coordinator)
Industry switching: Roofing shows different agents (Inbound Lead, Scheduling, Insurance Coordinator)
Color themes: MedSpa displays pink/violet theme, Roofing displays amber/orange theme
Company name persistence across all screens and industry switches
